citations.claim: pre-impact falling speed ~12.36 downward just before floor contact
post-bounce upward speed ~14.20 exceeds incoming speed despite e=1 which should at most preserve speed
total energy jumps from ~83.86 to ~108.99 across the bounce, exceeding allowed bound with zero controller work

counterfactual.change: changed restitution e from 1 to 0 only; inelastic bounce dissipates impact energy so no gain occurs and rule passes

explanation: Single ball in free fall hits arena floor between steps 55 and 56. With e=1 the bounce should at most reverse velocity, but speed grows 12.36->14.20 and energy 83.86->108.99 with no controller work. Likely cause: floor contact resolution adds positional correction (push-out) on a deeply penetrated fast body combined with impulse reflection plus gravity integrated in 8 substeps, net injecting energy instead of conserving it.
vision_note: A single small ball drops vertically toward the arena floor across steps 53 to 55 and makes contact at step 56. No other bodies, interior walls, or waypoints are visible, and there is no obvious tunneling or large jump in the stills.
